frozen: 2026-10-31, before any result of this search; after the e65 screens on dev31 (output/season_phase_20261031)
why: The latitude-mean land column's ice albedo is a function of its own temperature, so every land cell at a latitude inherits the average continent's snowy spring: across the mid-latitudes the model's springs are 2-5 C too cold and its autumns too warm (British Isles April -4.3 / October +0.8, eastern Europe -3.7 / +0.9, Pacific NW -2.6 / -0.2). e65 (ebm_land_ice) keeps only a share of the seasonal-snow albedo in the column (ice sheets keep all of it). Screens on dev31 against r40: ebm_land_ice 0.5 gives S 0.9927 (Alps, Pacific NW, eastern Europe 0.89-0.91) but warms East Asia and the US Midwest, which were already too warm; with continental_mean 7.0 S 0.9837 (T -3.3 %), holdout 1.0049. The search balances the column's snow share with the cold-air pool (continental_mean), the continental swing terms, the cells' own snowpack albedo (e16) and the land offset, with the retired sealed set as an extra guarded group.
score: scripts/gate_calibrate.py: S as scripts/gate_local.py over dev31 against the r40 run, plus 2 x every policy group's worsening, 2 x the retired sealed set's worsening, and 2 x any T or P worsening beyond 1 %
validation: OUT=output/land_ice_20261031/refit REF_NAME=r40 REF_FIT=calibration/local_accuracy_20261023/r40_params.json BEST=calibration/land_ice_refit_20261031/search/best_params.json SEALED_SPEC=calibration/sealed_20261031b/regions.json bash scripts/validate_monsoon_refit.sh: fresh paired dev31 runs under policy v2, the paired 28 km check, then sealed set b (declared 2026-10-31, never run) once if both pass; adoption also requires sealed set b not to get worse. Failing any step means nothing is adopted; every result is reported.
